name: Asuha
source:
A boy who works as a shoeshiner in the Yomi public square.
He aspires to be a doctor and he is [url=/c74514]Kuroba[/url]'s youngest friend.
He was raised in the same orphanage as [url=/c87446]Hairi[/url] and thinks of him as a brother.
